text:
Maria (Marketing): Heads-up — prepping EU press briefings for next Tuesday; embargo: 2026-05-15 17:00 UTC. Need: localized quotes for FR, DE, ES and a 24h fact-check window. Who can own quote approvals?
Sam (Comms): I'll own quote approvals. Can we keep base English quotes and have translators adapt? Prefer legal sign-off for DE outlets. :thumbsup:
Jess (Ops): We have Transly on retainer — they can do translation + QA. I'll ping them. Factpack link: https://redwood.internal/press/factpacks/eu-launch
PressBot: Calendar invite created: EU Press Briefing — 2026-05-14 09:00 CEST. attendees: @Maria, @Sam, @Ethan, @Linda
Ethan (Product): I'll be at the briefing. Can we limit tech quotes to 2 short lines? Prefer: `Redwood Inference reduces per-token latency by X%...` Will draft.
Maria (Marketing): yes — 2 lines max. Sam, can you add fallback nicknames for quotes for FR/DE? i.e., keep message tone but local idioms.
Linda (Legal): Heads up — DE press requires explicit data residency mention for some outlets. If translators change meaning, send to legal for sign-off. Also, avoid client names.
Sam (Comms): Noted. I'll post the base English quotes here by EOD. @Jess can you confirm Transly's SLA for 24h turnaround?
Jess (Ops): Confirmed — 24h for FR/DE/ES if we give final English by 2026-05-13 12:00 UTC. Otherwise 48h. Also need translation ticket: #TL-4321
Maria (Marketing): ok we need contingency: if translation delayed, can we release EN quotes and include 'local translation pending' note? risk?
Ethan (Product): I'd rather hold than risk mistranslation on technical claims. Suggest publish EN only to global press, and offer a translated factpack later.
Sam (Comms): Good point. Let's do EN only at embargo, with localized briefings scheduled within 48h. For press in FR/DE with legal constraints, we can offer one-on-one briefings.
PressBot: Reminder scheduled: send quote pool draft — 2026-05-13 10:00 UTC.
Maria (Marketing): draft quotes (EN) — please react :eyes: and add edits inline:
- "Redwood Inference reduces per-token latency by up to 45% compared to standard runtimes."
- "Our unified runtime lets teams trade-off latency and cost with predictable SLAs."
- "We support hosted, dedicated, and private deployments for regulated workloads."
Sam (Comms): Edits: tighten first claim -> 'up to 45% for large-context workloads under typical configs.' Also add a customer quote placeholder.
Ethan (Product): +1. I'll replace 'standard runtimes' with 'common open-source runtimes' and provide benchmark note.
Linda (Legal): Remove 'predictable SLAs' unless we say 'predictable performance with SLA options.' Also add KMS mention? Only if customer-approved.
Maria (Marketing): ok — final English quote owner: @Sam. Deadline to lock copy: 2026-05-13 12:00 UTC. After that @Jess kicks translation. Any objections?
Sam (Comms): none.
Jess (Ops): none.
PressBot: Quote pack uploaded: https://redwood.internal/press/quotes/2001234567-pkg (access=internal).
Maria (Marketing): thanks everyone. Follow-ups: Sam to finalize quotes; Ethan to add benchmark note; Jess to confirm Transly ticket TL-4321; Linda to pre-approve wording for DE data residency mention. We'll re-check in the briefing tomorrow.
